content: isinstance(obj, (int, float)) tuple-form is the idiomatic way to check multiple types in one call; passing a list to isinstance raises TypeError. For dispatching a function's behavior by argument shape (list-of-str vs tuple-of-floats), an isinstance check against the expected container type at the top of the function is the standard lightweight pattern; functools.singledispatch/multiple-dispatch libraries are the heavier alternative for many branches.
